LanguageData.QL_Settings_SpreadModifiersHint: When off: zones, isolation policy, and mood still work — no extra infection seeding from this mod.
LanguageData.QL_Settings_EasyModeHint: Lower spread chance, softer mood penalties, plague rarer from caravan events.
LanguageData.QL_Settings_EventsHint: Low storyteller chance; independent of vanilla disease incidents.
LanguageData.QL_Settings_SleepHint: With no infectious disease on player maps the component sleeps — no exposure work.
LanguageData.QL_Designator_Mark_Desc: Paint cells as a quarantine ward. Sick colonists here are contained; healthy visitors take higher exposure risk.
LanguageData.QL_Designator_Isolation_Desc: Click any cell to toggle strict isolation on this map. Strict mode lowers outbreak spread, raises patient loneliness and doctor workload.
LanguageData.QL_Disabled: Quarantine Line is disabled in settings.
LanguageData.QL_Gizmo_Strict_Desc: Toggle map isolation protocol. Contained sick spread less; patients and doctors pay mood.
LanguageData.QL_Gizmo_SendToWard_Desc: Mark a small ward around this sick colonist.
LanguageData.QL_Gizmo_ReleasePatient_Desc: Remove quarantine from this patient's cell.
LanguageData.QL_Msg_StrictOn: Strict isolation protocol ON — doors and distance matter more; patients lonelier, doctors busier.
LanguageData.QL_Msg_StrictOff: Strict isolation protocol OFF — open ward (still better than free-roaming sick).
LanguageData.QL_Letter_OutbreakBody:
Someone on the map is carrying an infectious disease.

Architect → Quarantine: mark a ward, optionally enable strict isolation. Visiting the ward raises spread risk; strict isolation lowers outbreak but costs patient mood and doctor workload.

Vanilla medicine and immunity still apply — this only tweaks exposure.
LanguageData.QL_Letter_OutbreakBodyStrict: Someone is sick and strict isolation is already on. Keep the ward sealed and staffed.
LanguageData.QL_Letter_CaravanDiseaseBody: {0} looks feverish after contact with travellers — {1}. Quarantine if you can.
LanguageData.QL_Letter_AnimalSourceBody: Colony animal {0} is sick with {1}. Keep colonists clear or mark a pen ward.
